name: Tropic
description: Software + AI pricing isn't public, so searching the internet won't tell you if you're overpaying. Tropic will. Connect Tropic to Claude to benchmark your pricing against $18B+ in verified technology transactions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Tropic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tropic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.tropicapp.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Tropic MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tropic lists 14 MCP tools, including get_supplier_intelligence, get_negotiation_playbook, run_price_benchmark, list_supplier_products, get_server_status, query_contract_documents, create_manual_benchmark_request, list_price_benchmarks, get_price_benchmark, list_contracts, list_expert_insights, and list_market_insights.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Tropic?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Tropic in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Tropic requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Tropic is developed by Tropic. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
